reading.body:
This facility's power capacity is not published. The operator, NTT, is a major global telecommunications and IT services conglomerate with operations across 33 countries, though no specific data center division financials or formation date appear in its public materials. The campus sits in Ashburn, Virginia, part of the largest data center cluster in the United States.

Virginia has 326 mapped data center facilities, of which only 23 publish power capacity figures totaling 1,375 megawatts. This campus does not appear in the published capacity list, placing it below the threshold of disclosure used by this site's sources. No power figure, cooling detail, architectural specification, or certification appears on any operator page this site could access.

Without published specifications, this campus cannot be ranked among Virginia's disclosed capacity or assessed for its role in AI infrastructure scaling. The absence of a dedicated facility page and unpublished capacity are consistent with colocation or smaller-scale operations that do not compete on transparency. Researchers tracking grid constraints on AI should prioritize the 23 facilities in Virginia that do publish power figures.
